# External data: frozen copies from the parent project

These files are **verbatim copies** of results produced in the parent
repository and are frozen here so that the comparison in
`docs/comparison_swap_test.md` is reproducible without network access.  They
are never regenerated by this repository's scripts; `tests/test_comparison.py`
checks their SHA-256 against the values below.

| file | source |
|---|---|
| `pqec_operational_threshold__fidelity_vs_round.csv` | `Han-JaeHoon/PQEC-Operational-Threshold`, branch `iterated-noisy-pqec`, path `results/fidelity_vs_round/fidelity_vs_round.csv` |
| `pqec_operational_threshold__fidelity_vs_round_metadata.json` | same, path `results/fidelity_vs_round/metadata.json` |

- branch tip at copy time: `1a938b659bdc17027e947f28a835692df85c0485`
- git blob of the CSV: `d8e2508101e42f27707feda7da2def7ba09048b2`
- SHA-256 (CSV): `8ac7c7394489d902e6a15b7e3c94354da4b6a980268da3718485888026b72fd9`
- SHA-256 (metadata): `78f69237ad64ee199fe1ab56532b35e9e64408812f501673add81ade0f5fbca5`
- copied: 2026-09-03T12:47:32Z

Contents: Bell fidelity `F_n` versus PQEC round `n` (`n = 0..5000`) for the
parent project's Step 3 (textbook 16-CNOT), Step 4 (resynthesized 14-CNOT) and
Step 5 (learned 14-CNOT, exact-compilation calibrated) circuits, all from the
Bell-isotropic input `rho(eps_bar, eps_bar)`, `eps_bar = 0.9`, under per-CNOT
replacement depolarizing `q = 0.01` — the condition of Figure 1 of the parent
project's "Main Results" note.  Series used here: `step3`, `step4`, `step5`
(the `*_raw`, `*_uv_closed_form` and `step5_uncalibrated` control series are
kept but not used).  The metadata file records the parent project's own
validation of those runs.
